purpose: Current and target scan-scope behavior for every finding-producing find-* skill. Current modes are observed entrypoint behavior; target modes are the bounded AC1 rollout contract.

review.rule: A diff either filters line-local findings, seeds wider analysis, or triggers project analysis. It never blindly clips semantic or project findings.

scope_config.reason: The detector follows async producer/consumer relationships from caller-supplied paths and has not adopted the shared descriptor loader.

skills.rationale: Changed files can seed lifecycle reachability, but findings may legitimately cite unchanged producers, consumers, and cleanup paths.

scope_config.reason: Language-specific inventories and caller paths define the current universe; shared project/skill descriptors are not yet consumed.

skills.rationale: Each advisory finding names a current source line, so closeout may filter output to changed hunks while whole-file and project scans remain explicit options.

scope_config.reason: Each language provider owns its source inventory and exclusions rather than the shared descriptor loader.

skills.rationale: A changed line selects the containing function or method; complexity is a whole-symbol property and cannot be hunk-clipped.

scope_config.reason: The glossary plus language-local inventories define the scan universe and explicit exclusions.

skills.rationale: A changed use can seed a glossary concept, but divergence is established only by comparing every relevant live site.

scope_config.reason: The detector consumes the common scope loader and host-authored contract sections.

skills.rationale: A changed endpoint, template, or client can seed a contract, while the authoritative comparison spans multiple files.

scope_config.reason: Route, template, and JavaScript surfaces are resolved by the detector's topology rules.

skills.rationale: A changed route surface seeds the check, but deadness depends on unchanged definitions, links, templates, and callers.

scope_config.reason: The docs root and root URL configuration are explicit project-level inputs.

skills.rationale: A relevant diff can trigger the audit, but route documentation truth requires the complete declared docs and URL surfaces.

scope_config.reason: Language providers and explicit targets define first-party code; Python also uses specialist tools and scout review.

skills.rationale: Changed symbols can seed review, but dormancy depends on project-wide references and framework entry points.

scope_config.reason: Each language clone provider owns its target roots, exclusions, and eligible symbol inventory.

skills.rationale: A changed member can seed a clone search, but a duplication finding necessarily cites at least two complete sites.

scope_config.reason: The detector consumes common roots/ignores and adds explicit language-root selectors.

skills.rationale: A changed filename can seed its sibling folder, but promotion/demotion evidence depends on the complete sibling set.

scope_config.reason: The detector consumes common scope descriptors plus host-authored frontend contract sections.

skills.rationale: A template or script diff can trigger the audit, but boot-contract truth requires all declared producers and consumers.

scope_config.reason: The inventory and scanners consume common scope data while comparing project-wide primitive ownership.

skills.rationale: A frontend diff can trigger the audit, but duplication and primitive-bypass claims require complete comparison sites.

scope_config.reason: Language-local providers and explicit target/config inputs define the eligible symbol universe.

skills.rationale: A changed state operation selects a symbol or authority comparison; the full declaration and uses remain relevant.

scope_config.reason: The scanner combines explicit path bands, language providers, and Git trajectory rather than common scope descriptors.

skills.rationale: The diff and history seed an intended sweep, but majority and straggler evidence spans unchanged sibling call sites.

scope_config.reason: The detector consumes common scope plus host-authored layer maps.

skills.rationale: A changed dependency can seed the check, but boundary ownership and the prohibited edge may live on separate sites.

scope_config.reason: Each syntax provider inventories complete files under an explicit target.

skills.rationale: A changed file is the seed, while mixed-responsibility evidence requires its complete declaration set.

scope_config.reason: Each mode reads project ledgers, plans, TODO tuning, reports, or importance declarations as a complete state surface.

skills.rationale: Orphan status is project-state and time/history based; a code diff is not a meaningful finding filter.

scope_config.reason: The source inventory and detector declarations define a complete project coverage matrix.

skills.rationale: Coverage blind spots are defined across the full first-party source perimeter, not a changed subset.

scope_config.reason: The AST detector scans explicit target roots with its own layer exclusions.

skills.rationale: A changed line selects the complete read-named function whose body establishes the mutation finding.

scope_config.reason: Root URL discovery and product-topology rules define the project route universe.

skills.rationale: A route diff can trigger the audit, but sprawl is a comparison across the complete include and prefix graph.

scope_config.reason: The agent-rule root, onboarding entry, and linked load-on-demand documents form one complete surface.

skills.rationale: A rule/doc diff can trigger the audit, but reachability and size drift require the complete rule surface.

scope_config.reason: Language-native providers own their project/config inventory and candidate boundaries.

skills.rationale: A changed function can seed candidate search, while a useful lead compares complete functions, callers, and capability evidence.

scope_config.reason: The detector inventories skill directories or explicitly named skills rather than host source descriptors.

skills.rationale: Changed skill paths can select owned skill directories, but prose-to-artifact checks examine the complete selected skill.

scope_config.reason: The scanner joins the complete skill and contract inventories; changed paths can only select rows.

skills.rationale: A changed skill can seed comparison, while intent drift requires its complete frontmatter, prose, contract, and history.

scope_config.reason: The plans/reports roots and age budgets define a complete project working-artifact surface.

skills.rationale: Staleness is age and active-reference based; a current code diff is not a meaningful filter.

scope_config.reason: Declared standard scopes and language-specific inventories define the applicable source universe.

skills.rationale: Changed sites can seed standard checks, while applicability may depend on declarations or guards outside the hunk.

scope_config.reason: The detector intentionally maps an explicit path or Git-diff file set to verification obligations.

skills.rationale: Obligations attach to complete changed files and project test surfaces; deletion and binary changes still require file-level treatment.
